steps.what: Sum stored covers and item quantities
Estimate food, liquor, and wine consumption
Set requisitioned amounts to be purchased
Sign the consumption estimate
File the signed consumption estimate
outputs: filed copy of signed consumption estimate v1

tasks.design: A job sums stored covers and item quantities in {ERP}. The manager estimates food, liquor, wine, and other beverage consumption and sets the requisitioned amounts. A later job files the signed estimate in {DOCS}. It does not place the order.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sales were rekeyed before the estimate.
tasks.enabler_now: Item identifier, quantity, and cover count are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The manager still judges the next week.
tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the estimate, not on summing sales.

reach.task: Order only after a separate signature

evidence.claim: The executive digest says budgets and records come from the booking or ledger system, and a person checks the commentary against the figures.

assumptions: Item identifier, quantity, and cover count are stored on the ledger record. The ledger record produces them. A blank quantity stays blank and is not summed as zero.
Native configuration of the ledger record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
Filing the estimate does not place an order.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining estimate is still the manager estimating consumption.

incremental.description: Refresh item identifier, quantity, and cover count when the ledger layout changes, and drop an estimate the manager has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many quantities are blank. The high end assumes item identifier, quantity, and cover count are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

evidence.claim: The executive digest says strategy and people work stay manual.

Native configuration of the document record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
The job does not score a plate from a camera.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining watch is still the manager monitoring preparation.

incremental.description: Refresh dish identifier and portion amount when the document layout changes, and drop a note the manager has not signed.

steps.what: List checks due by the inspection interval
Monitor health and fire regulations
Check building maintenance in the facility
Sign the compliance note
File the signed compliance note
outputs: filed copy of signed compliance note v1

tasks.design: A job lists checks in {OPS_SYSTEM} that are due because the stored inspection interval has passed. The manager monitors health and fire regulations and building maintenance in person. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not send a report to an inspectorate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Due checks were copied before the walk.
tasks.enabler_now: Check identifier, interval, and last check date are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The kitchen is still walked by the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides whether the rule was met.
tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the walk, not on finding due checks.

reach.task: Fix only what the signed note names

evidence.claim: The executive digest says strategy and people work stay manual.

assumptions: Check identifier, interval, and last check date are stored on the operations record. The operations record produces them. A check is due when the interval has passed since the last check date. A blank interval is shown as not due.
Native configuration of the operations record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
Filing the note does not send it to an inspectorate.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining walk is still the manager monitoring the regulations.

incremental.description: Refresh check identifier, interval, and last check date when the operations layout changes, and drop a note the manager has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the inspection interval is often blank. The high end assumes check identifier, interval, and last check date are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

Test by smelling for flavor conformity

role.altitude: The food service manager spends the week on the floor, the guest, and the signed decision. A stored total, a working-time slot with no name, and filing that decision can move. The manager still counts the cash, tastes the food, and assigns the names.
reach: A cook follows only the assignment the manager signed.
A supplier receives only the order the manager signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a roster slot that already contains a person name.
Reject a total that does not match the stored rows.
Reject an order that the manager has not signed.
role.ambitious_version: A signed roster or order can be filed the same week, and the manager still owns the floor.
